why: Aires & Kahn (arXiv:2509.11549, Sept 2025, and follow-up arXiv:2510.26134, Oct 2025) prove new asymptotic bounds on the balance constant δ(P) for posets of large/bounded width, including δ(P) ≥ 1/e - o(1) and δ(P) -> 1/2 in some regimes, directly improving bounds on the conjecture's own quantity rather than a variant problem; the full conjecture (balance constant >= 1/3 for all non-chain posets) remains open.
